scenario.description: Verify runtime discovery, portable Skill loading, controlled execution, validation, failure recovery, and evidence reporting without granting unrestricted permissions.
scenario.prompt: Read the repository instructions and the portable Skill fixture at tests/validation/fixtures/portable-skill/SKILL.md. Report the Skill name exactly as shown in its front matter, then report the repository standard version. Do not modify files, access secrets, make network requests, or invoke external tools beyond what is required to read the two files.
